entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I'm so sleepy.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: "In spring, the sleeper[n]knows not the hour of dawn."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji's like that all[n]year round though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yup, he's the same as always.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You guys, we're in the[n]middle of class!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Our third semester is almost[n]over, so at least try to[n]pay attention for now.
entries.uk: Третій семестр майже скінчився,[n]тож бодай зараз[n]спробуйте слухати.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hahaha. Mako-chan is the[n]same as always too.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, I know! It's been far too[n]long since our last meetup. How[n]about we get together tomorrow?
entries.uk: О, придумала! Ми надто давно[n]не збиралися. Може,[n]зустрінемося завтра?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Count me in! Whaddya[n]think, [fName]?
entries.uk: Я в ділі! А ти що[n]скажеш, [fName]?

entries.en: Of course.
Either way's fine.
I'm too sleepy.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's settled then. Want[n]to meet up at Leblanc?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sounds like a plan to me![n]Let's meet at Leblanc!
entries.uk: Як на мене, план що треба![n]Зустрічаємося в Леблані!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You too, [fName]...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, he can get over that.[n]Let's meet up at Leblanc!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should head over there[n]separately, just to be safe.
entries.uk: Нам варто йти туди окремо,[n]про всяк випадок.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That would be wise. We don't[n]want the police to suspect[n]anything of us.
entries.uk: Розважливо. Нам не треба,[n]щоб поліція щось[n]запідозрила.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Though it's likely OK considering[n]how long we've been laying low.
entries.uk: Утім, найпевніше, все гаразд,[n]адже ми вже давно[n]не висовуємося.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Roger roger. I'll tell Sojiro[n]that everyone's gonna show up.
